messages:
maya: Hey team — PR #65432 touches routing auth header ordering and the fallback path. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before we can schedule canary. @sam-runtime @li @jess-security can you take a look? Hoping to merge in tomorrow's 10:00am PT merge window if all good. TL;DR: reorder headers in router, add extra check in auth middleware, small perf tweak.

sam: I can look this afternoon. Quick Q: does this change any existing auth header ordering contracts with external clients?

li: Not that I saw in the spec. But I'll run the local e2e and smoke tests. What's the test cmd?

maya: run `./scripts/integration.sh --route tests/auth` — it covers the new branch. Also CI has extra job: `ci-bot` will run perf baseline. I added a canary runbook in the PR description. PTAL at the `Canary Plan` section.

jess-security: I'll skim for auth regressions. If it's touching header ordering we should check SSO proxy as well. I'll ping the SSO owner.

devops-bot: CI queued for PR #65432 — unit, integration, canary-smoke. ETA ~25m.

sam: got a failing test locally — kv-eviction test flakes on my machine. Stacktrace in PR comments. Is that expected? maya?

maya: ugh — not expected. I reran the test matrix in CI; flake only on python3.9 worker. I added a mitigation in the PR (retry on transient load). If sam confirms it's the same flake we can mark CI as non-blocking for the canary.

li: smoke passed locally. perf looks fine. two nits in the code review (naming + comment). otherwise lgtm from infra perspective.

jess-security: skipped SSO proxy impact — looks safe. One security nit: log sanitization for the auth header needs a slice. I'll add the comment.

platform-oncall: if you want the 10:00am PT slot, please add me as merge-steward and ping again at least 30m before. Also put the fallback flag `--enable-old-routing` behind a feature flag so we can quickly rollback.

maya: added feature flag `old_routing_fallback` and set default off. Added platform-oncall as merge-steward. Updated runbook with rollback steps. Thanks!

ci-bot: CI passed on main matrix. Canary-smoke succeeded in staging. Marking PR as canary-ready.

sam: re-running tests now that maya added retry. will re-approve if green.

li: approved.

jess-security: approved.

platform-oncall: queued for 10:00am PT merge window. I'll handle the rollout and monitor. add the canary alert channel to the runbook: #prod-canary.

maya: thanks all :tada: I'll merge at 10:00am PT if no further blockers. will post final status here.
